title: Meet a stranger with no time and no place
hook: You must meet a stranger in New York tomorrow. No time, no place, no phone. Where do you go?
caption: Meet a stranger in New York with no time and no place: many of Schelling's students picked Grand Central at noon. A Schelling point wins by being obvious, not best.
cta: Follow QuanTik for the game theory of real life

headline: NO PHONE.
STILL
MET.

scenes.say: You must meet a stranger in New York tomorrow. No time, no place, no phone. Where do you go?
A Schelling point: the choice people land on without talking, because it stands out.
The chain: no contact, guess what they'll guess, pick the most obvious point, meet.
Thomas Schelling asked students exactly this. A huge share picked Grand Central, at noon.
scenes.note: Source: Schelling (1960), The Strategy of Conflict

scenes.say: The meeting point doesn't need to be best. It needs to be the most obvious.
When you can't coordinate in advance, pick the obvious option, not the clever one.

takeaway: When you can't coordinate in advance, pick the obvious option, not the clever one.
